Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office (contact: Tamaira Hawkins, thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us, 410-260-7533) is seeking bids for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops with extended 3-year warranty and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), with detailed specifications including Intel Core Ultra 5 processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 256GB SSD, and Windows 11 Pro. Bids must be submitted electronically through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) system by 06/10/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT, with delivery required within 45 days of award. The contract utilizes the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007), and bidders must provide a Mercury Affidavit and a Letter of Authorization from Dell upon request. Invoices must be submitted within 10 days of equipment delivery.
